title: Recessed-Rim Flying Disc
description: One newly authored static low-poly sports flying-disc visual prop. A single continuous sixteen-sided closed shell joins a broad solid top, sloping shoulder and thick turned-down outer rim around a genuine downward-open blind underside cavity. The complete flat annular rim is the ground sole; the central underside is open air beneath the roof rather than a filled cylinder. One connected closed mesh and two opaque constant untextured PBR materials, one prop and zero scenes. Material zones use the original shell faces. The full nonconvex inward-offset shell and the complete inward-offset cavity core are separately declared finite volumes. One component gives an exact empty pair universe, zero assembly contacts and zero noncontact pairs. Metres, Z up, front -Y, horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. Original numeric profile and finite ring construction; no old mesh, spinning-top, ball, diabolo or ingot geometry is copied, transformed or recoloured. This is static visual game art: no aerodynamics, flight, throwing distance, sport regulation, balance, human suitability, impact, manufacture or safety performance is claimed.
